cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline desktop business assistant for African SMEs: generative data charts, shift scheduling, fraud alerts, and tool calls with zero cloud dependency.

test_prompts.prompt: Generate a chart showing the distribution of pallet SKU types across our warehouse zones: Zone A has 400 pallets, Zone B has 350 pallets, Zone C has 150 pallets, and Zone D has 100 pallets.
How can our retail store reduce cashier discrepancy losses during peak hours without slowing down checkout queues?
